newsitem.title: DUBAI: Abu Dhabi sets up committee to lure investment.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi sets up committee to lure investment.

text.p: Abu Dhabi has set up a committee to lure investment as part of efforts to diversify its oil-driven economy, newspapers reported on Sunday.

The Higher Consultative Committee for Development of Abu Dhabi will define development strategies, identify obstacles to investments in tourism, trade, services and construction and ease investment procedures in the emirate.
The committee will be chaired by Sheikh Sultan bin Khalifa al-Nahayan, son of Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khalifa bin Zaid al-Nahayan.
